notes: «وغيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter, the surface is «غيره»
«حدثنا بذلك» is a second isnad for the same saying: its route stops at أبي إسحاق as written, the names of Asim and Ali are not repeated and no tail is written
«وقد رواه منصور بن المعتمر عن أبي إسحاق» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, never a route
«وهذا أصح من حديث أبي بكر بن عياش» is a grading remark; Abu Bakr b. Ayyash is named only as comparison, so no group is read for him
